viewsWelcome.apsTeamAdminView.5:
The Team Admin API (Beta) is disabled. Enabling it requests additional scopes when you sign in, and requires the Team Admin API to be enabled for your APS app.
[Enable Team Admin API](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22autodesk.forge.enableTeamAdminApi%22%5D)
After enabling the setting, sign out and sign in again with 3-legged OAuth.

configuration.viewer.extensions.descript: Viewer extensions to be used when previewing derivatives.
configuration.viewer.env.description: Custom Model Derivative environment used by the APS Viewer. By default, the viewer will determine the appropriate environment based on the viewable output format (SVF vs SVF2).
configuration.viewer.api.description: Custom Model Derivative API used by the APS Viewer. By default, the viewer will determine the appropriate API based on the viewable output format (SVF vs SVF2).
configuration.data.defaultContentType.de: When defined, all uploaded files and empty objects created in OSS will use this content type.
configuration.data.uploadChunkSize.descr: Size of individual chunks (in bytes) when uploading files to OSS with the resumable functionality.
configuration.data.pageSize.description: Number of buckets/objects to fetch per page in the Data & Derivatives (app) tree view, before showing a "Load more" item.
configuration.data.hubsPageSize.descript: Number of projects/folder items/versions to fetch per page in the Data & Derivatives (user) tree view, before showing a "Load more" item.
configuration.enableTeamAdminApi.descrip: Enable the Team Admin (user) view for the Team Admin API (Beta). When enabled, signing in with 3-legged OAuth requests additional scopes (tmadmapi:team:read, tmadmapi:team-users:write, tmadmapi:team-products:write), so your APS app must have the Team Admin API enabled. Sign in again after changing this setting.
